panel.title: TeamShuffler Setup
panel.description:
Configure your server for team shuffle games.

Use the buttons below to get started.

category.created: Category **{name}** created with 3 voice channels ready to use.
category.reconfigured: Category reconfigured — 3 voice channels are ready.

role.title: Set Game Manager Role
role.description: Select the role that will be able to run `/game`. Server admins can always run it.

language.title: Change Language
language.description: Choose the language for all bot messages on this server.

error.no_config:
This server isn't configured yet.

Ask an admin to run `/setup` to get started.
error.not_in_voice: You need to be in a voice channel to create teams.
error.not_in_creation: You're not in a **Team Creation** channel.
error.move_suggestion: Want me to move everyone to an available creation channel?
error.no_available_channel: All creation channels are currently occupied. Wait for one to free up.
error.not_enough_members: You need at least **2 members** in the channel to create teams.
error.no_permission: Only **Game Managers** or server admins can start a game.
error.move_failed: Couldn't move all members — make sure I have the **Move Members** permission.
error.not_invoker: Only the person who ran `/game` can use these buttons.
error.state_expired: This game proposal has expired. Run `/game` again to start fresh.
error.bot_permissions: I'm missing some permissions. Check that I have **Manage Channels** and **Move Members**.

odd_members.title: {count} members — choose a format
odd_members.description: The number of members is odd. Pick the team configuration you want:

game.moved: Moved **{count}** members to {channel}. You can now run `/game`.

started.title: Game #{id} started!
started.description: Teams have been moved to their voice channels. Have fun!

game.ended: Game #{id} is over — channels have been cleaned up.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.bot_permissions: I'm missing some permissions. Check my role and try again.
